overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: it declined to review the quorum-membership complaint as outside the law, and credited commissioners' denials of any out-of-meeting deliberation on the storm water permit.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the commission lacked a quorum of the same commissioners who heard a 2007-related matter, so the current panel could not decide the permit.
allegations.key_passage: The Law does not govern whether particular individuals must comprise the quorum of the public body at any particular time.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the commission discussed a storm water permit outside meetings, making its approval a predetermined outcome of the hearing.
allegations.key_passage: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, we credit their account and find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
